ui.title: THE TAVERN
ui.hint: Select someone to talk. Escape: close / leave.
ui.askForWork: Heard of anyone needing a detective?
ui.leadsAvailable: Word gets around. Whether it should is another matter.
ui.leadsEmpty: Nothing I can point you to today. Try the office classifieds later.
ui.completedRumor: You already closed that one. Good. I was running out of irresponsible theories.
ui.activeRumor: You have already taken that job. I can offer moral support, but not an alibi.
ui.rumorDisclaimer: The full notice is in your office classifieds. Hearing a rumor does not accept a job.
ui.boardIntro: Local opportunities. Some more advisable than others.
ui.boardEmpty: No notices available. The classifieds could not be loaded.

bartender.name: Bartender
bartender.greeting: Welcome. If you are looking for trouble, try the menu.

chat.question: How is business?
chat.answer: People come here to forget. Then they forget to pay.

chat.question: You polish that glass a lot.
chat.answer: It has seen things. I am trying to remove the evidence.

regular.name: The Regular
regular.greeting: Sit down. I have a theory. Several, actually. None improved by evidence.

chat.question: What is your theory?
chat.answer: The pigeons work for someone. Nobody walks that confidently without a pension.

chat.question: Is this your usual table?
chat.answer: We have an understanding. I support it emotionally. Those beer mats handle the structural work.

chat.question: Anything in the newspaper?
chat.answer: Yesterday I was worried about tomorrow. Today the paper confirms I was right.

guest.name: Woman in the Mustard Coat
guest.greeting: If you are selling insurance, I am already anxious enough.

chat.question: Waiting for someone?
chat.answer: No. That is the beauty of it. Nobody can be late.

chat.question: Nice place.
chat.answer: The coffee is terrible, but nobody asks me to join a mailing list.

chat.question: Do you come here often?
chat.answer: Only when I need peace. So, increasingly often.

rumors.dead_mail: Florence Finch says someone delivered a parcel to her grave. Awkward, considering she is still using her body.
rumors.dead_men_calling: A widow says her late husband keeps leaving phone messages. Apparently even death does not improve communication.
rumors.stolen_alibi: Someone says three strangers used them as a dinner alibi. They ate alone. Imagine having your social life stolen before you even acquire one.
